export const REQUEST_FOR_BOOKING_SEARCH_OPTIONS = [
  { id: "ids", name: "Application ID", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "name_of_emp_or_business", name: "Name Of Business", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "disbursed_date", name: "Disbursed Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "commencement_date", name: "Commencement Date", type: "date" },
  {
    id: "interest_first_installment_prorata_interest",
    name: "Prora Interest",
    type: "text_field",
  },
  { id: "first_due_date", name: "First Due Date", type: "date" },
  {
    id: "monthly_installment_amount",
    name: "Monthly Installment Amount",
    type: "text_field",
  },
  { id: "category_id", name: "Category", type: "autocomplete_category" },
  {
    id: "sub_category_id",
    name: "Sub Category",
    type: "autocomplete_sub_category",
  },
  { id: "applicant_name", name: "Applicant Name", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "nrc", name: "NRC", type: "text_field" },
  {
    id: "living_phone_number",
    name: "Living Phone Number",
    type: "text_field",
  },
  { id: "loan_amount", name: "Loan Amount", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "approved_amount", name: "Approved Amount", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "status_array", name: "Status", type: "autocomplete_status" },
  { id: "overdue_status", name: "Overdue Status", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "mnet_township", name: "MNet Township", type: "text_field" },
  {
    id: "address_township_id",
    name: "Current Township",
    type: "autocomplete_township",
  },
  { id: "address_ward_id", name: "Current Ward", type: "autocomplete_ward" },
  { id: "applied_date", name: "Applied Date", type: "date" },
];
